segments.name: Forgings and machined components
products: OEM and aftermarket components for aircraft and industrial gas turbine engines
segments.description: Manufacturer of forgings, machined components and sub-assemblies for aerospace and defense, energy and commercial space customers, operating as a single business segment.
segments.evidence: SIFCO is engaged in the production of forgings, sub-assemblies, and machined components primarily for the Aerospace and Energy ("A&E") markets.

changes.text: In October 2024, the Company sold its European operations, CBlade S.p.A. Forging & Manufacturing, which is presented as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: In October 2024, the Company sold its European operations in order to streamline operational synergies and refocus on its core aerospace forging business.
